data.text: [00:00]CD2 Track 8
H = Helen, D = Daniel
[00:04]Hi Daniel. Have you finished doing your essay? `[00:08]I want to show you something … just five minutes … it won’t take long.
[00:13.9]Yes, sure. I’ve decided not to do my essay now, actually. `[00:19]It’s really difficult and Michael has offered to help me later. `[00:23]What do you want to do?
[00:24.9]Well, erm … I want to look at the shape of your fingers.
[00:30]What? … Why?
[00:32.8]I’m going to tell you about your personality.
[00:36]Oh … hmm … I’m not sure about that. `[00:41]What are you going to say about me?! You have to promise to be nice!
[00:45.7]Well, we’ll see what your fingers say!
[00:49]Oh, OK … why not? I enjoy doing this kind of thing actually. `[00:54]So, where do we start?
[00:56.8]OK, well, erm … there are three main things to look at.
[01:02]Mmm …

[01:03]First, there’s the length of your fingers. `[01:06.9]People with long, slim fingers are quite sensitive. `[01:11]People with shorter, thicker fingers, like yours, are more open. `[01:17]They talk about their feelings more. So, you’re quite an open person …

[01:23.4]No, I’m not sure about that … Actually, I don’t think I’m very open. `[01:28.6]I think I avoid telling people about my feelings most of the time … . `[01:33]In fact, I don’t think I talk about my feelings much at all.
[01:36.5]Yes, you do …
[01:37.9]I don’t think so, really … only to really close family and friends. `[01:43.5]I mean, I’d never even consider showing my feelings to someone I didn’t know.
[01:48.7]No, well, obviously not … but you seem to be quite open with people you know – that’s what I mean.
[01:55]Well … I’m really not sure – but let’s move on. `[02:00]What else then?
[02:01.9]Well, secondly, there’s the shape of your fingers. `[02:06]Are your fingers straight?
[02:08]Erm … yes … I think they are quite straight.
[02:12.4]Ermm … that means you’re organised. Is that true?

[02:19]Yes. I think that’s true about me. `[02:22.9]I mean, especially with writing essays and things … I’m very organised. `[02:27]You can’t afford to be disorganised really. `[02:30]There’s so much work at university … it all piles up if you’re not organised about it.
[02:36]Yes …
[02:37]So, you said I’m open, organised … OK … what else?
[02:44]Well, finally, the thumb is very important. `[02:48]Let’s see how long your thumb is …
[02:51.8]Hmm … I think it’s quite long.
[02:54.9]Well, a long thumb means you’re ambitious. `[02:58]You know, you really want to be successful in what you do. `[03:02]You’ve got quite a long thumb, so I guess you’re quite ambitious.

[03:06.8]That’s absolutely right! `[03:08.5]I think I am ambitious … yes. Hmmm … not bad … you said I’m ambitious, yes, organised, yes … and open, well, I’m still not sure about that one … but not bad, I suppose.
[03:25.4]Mmm … I think that’s quite accurate, actually.
[03:28.7]OK, now it’s your turn! Let me look at your hands …
